# License API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

A regulatory authorization the lab works under, such as an animal research approval.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/license/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/personal_attributes/license/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `license` (detail, create, update), `licenses` (list)
- **Permissions:** object permissions on the record itself (member / manager / owner roles)
- **Deleting:** also deletes the linked [`licensegroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/licensegroupmembershipinvitation/), [`licensemembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/licensemembershipinvitation/) records

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 255 characters. Name/title of the license (e.g., "PPL: Septo-hippocampal dynamics 2025-2028") |
| `type` | one of `animal_research_authorization`, `human_research_authorization`, `biosafety_gmo_authorization`, `wildlife_fieldwork_permit`, `controlled_substance_license`, `chemical_use_authorization`, `import_export_permit` **[required]**. Type of authorization or license |
| `status` | one of `draft`, `pending`, `active`, `suspended`, `expired`, `revoked` **[required]**. Current status of the license |
| `description` | string; nullable. Detailed description of the license scope and purpose |
| `country` | string; nullable. Country where the license was issued (ISO country code) |
| `regulatory_authority` | [`regulatoryauthority`](/api/taxonomies/regulatoryauthority/) id; nullable. Regulatory authority that issued the license (select from standardized list or add new authority in Taxonomies) |
| `license_number` | string; max 128 characters. Official license number on the approval document |
| `license_document` | string; max 100 characters. Upload the official license document as a PDF (10 MB maximum) |
| `valid_from` | date; nullable. Date when the license becomes valid |
| `valid_until` | date; nullable. Date when the license expires |
| `license_holders` | list of [`user`](/api/users/user/) ids. Named license holders (e.g., PIs, authorized personnel) |
| `behavioralassays` | list of [`behavioralassay`](/api/personal_attributes/behavioralassay/) ids **[read-only]**; nullable; nestable |
| `subjects` | list of [`subject`](/api/stem/subject/) ids **[read-only]**; nullable; nestable |
| `procedures` | list of [`procedure`](/api/modules/procedure/) ids **[read-only]**; nullable; nestable |
| `is_public` | boolean. Designates if the license information is publicly available |
| `created_at` | datetime **[read-only]**; nullable |
| `updated_at` | datetime **[read-only]** |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |
| `users` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `groups` | computed **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/license/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('license', load_all=True)
records = resp['licenses']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('license', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.licenses;
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/license/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('license', data={"name": "License 1", "type": "animal_research_authorization", "status": "active"})
record = resp.json()['license']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'License 1', 'type', 'animal_research_authorization', 'status', 'active'), 'license');
record = created.license;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/license/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found


## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/license/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('license', id='<id>', data={"name": "License 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'License 1 (renamed)'), 'license', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/license/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('license', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'license');
```
